status: Candidate bounded network preference durability, connection ownership and settings accessibility checkpoint. Independent final evidence acceptance and integration pending; overall production readiness remains open.

browser.matrix: en/ru/akk/egy × 320/390px × 100/200% text; actual mouse reachability, layout and glyph bounds; full Chrome restarts after custom node, fallback deletion and favorite persistence.

limits: Unsigned developer-loaded popup and CSP only; no AMO acceptance, historical Firefox upgrade, Linux runtime, or hardware signing claim.

behavior: Network preferences read, compare and write inside the actual storage queue. Unread or malformed settings reject truthfully; successful commands publish only after durable acknowledgement. Failed edits preserve disk, runtime and unsaved form input, and retry remains possible.

Open editors retain their original preference snapshot. Atomic conflict checks reject stale current-provider/custom-node writes; historically omitted empty customProviders normalize to the displayed empty value. Queued status saves read the latest runtime map and cannot undo acknowledged reactivation.

Favorites carry the intended state and captured wallet identity, preserving concurrent intent and rejecting stale ownership. Auto/manual selection and active-node deletion wait for acknowledgement; deletion commits default-provider fallback atomically. The native checkbox remains controlled during held and rejected writes.

Substrate and SORA connection attempts own their APIs, providers and callbacks. Superseded attempts cannot delete or publish over a newer connection; SORA static fees are initialized through isolated SDK state and published only for the current attempt.

Node controls fit 320/390px and enlarged text in four locales; addresses shrink with ellipsis, URL rows permit full glyph height, long headings and button words wrap. Pending saves lock duplicate edits and late replies cannot dismiss a newer route or dialog.
preservedDiagnostics: Actual-service, actual-store, mounted-editor, provider and native-switch baselines reproduce failures before their fixes. Invalid detached input, early harness and SORA fixture-name attempts are preserved separately and are not acceptance evidence.

remainingGates: Broader approved sun-disc branding, offline network-icon fallback, full application font/accessibility matrix and remaining design work stay open. Broken offline external images visible in settings captures are not accepted as final design.
